the diagnosis of MTBI is based on a combination of clinical features, including a brief loss of consciousness, transient confusion or disorientation, loss of memory for events immediately before or after the accident, or transient post‐traumatic amnesia, and the exclusion of intracranial lesions by appropriate imaging techniques.

there is no one-size-fits-all approach to the diagnosis and management of mild traumatic brain injury.
